A little more about me ↓
A way of seeing

Art meets interaction.

I started with objects, materials, and the question of how something makes you feel. Fine arts taught me to notice the small things: a gesture, a texture, the space between two forms.

That attention now shapes my work in product design. I move between a sketch, a prototype, and the code that brings an idea to life.

Always learning

Research meets making.

I’m completing my MS at USC Iovine and Young Academy, following an MFA at Claremont Graduate University and a BA in Design at UC Davis.

My work brings design and technology into the same conversation, from visualizing curriculum connections to exploring how we experience physical products in space.
